summary: Warner cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to apply the IHRA definition in campus investigations. He has also co-sponsored a resolution urging the administration to break Gaza's blockade, co-authored a Foreign Relations Committee statement on Israeli operations, and voted to advance a bulldozer ban for Israel while opposing a ban on 1,000-pound bomb bodies. In January 2025 he called the ceasefire the 'best chance for peace,' framing both sides' hopes for an end to the war.
